title: Sections of a pullback counit and the normalized Leray unit
statement: Let $g:T\to S$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme] and choose independently sheaf and module derived localizations [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $C$ be a complex of modules on $S$, and let $\epsilon:Q_h Lg^*\to g^*Q_h$ be a natural transformation with the displayed Hom-equivalence normalization for the pinned derived adjunction [def-pc-derived-base-change-map], evaluated at the identity of the homotopy pullback of $C$. Conjugate $\epsilon_C$ by the complex/homotopy quotient factors to get $e:Lg^*Q(C)\to Q(g^*C)$. Then the ordinary-to-derived sections comparison followed by derived sections of the pullback unit, normalized Leray [lem-sc-mixed-global-sections-direct-image-iso], and restriction of derived sections of $e$, equals localization of sections of the ordinary pullback unit followed by the exact scalar restriction factor and restriction of the T-sections comparison. The exact equation is lean.statement. No affine, K-flat, boundedness or invertibility assumption is made. Sections and pullback functors are additive.

source.place: Tags 079W and 0D5T; formal unit/naturality calculation in step 3 of lem-sc-mixed-affine-pullback-unit-normalization, with complex localization factors.

proof.text: Use Adjunction.homEquiv_id and homEquiv_unit to rewrite the supplied normalization as the derived unit followed by derived direct image of epsilon equals localization of the ordinary homotopy unit followed by the direct-image right-derived unit.

The elementwise identity clause of exists_mixedGlobalSectionsDirectImageIso identifies its underived comparison with Iso.refl by extensionality. Apply naturality of the Leray comparison at epsilon, combine maps using the normalization, and use naturality of the sections right-derived unit at the ordinary homotopy unit. The defining Leray unit equation now gives the homotopy sections identity.

On complexes, quotientCompQhIso and mapHomotopyCategoryFactors have identity components. Expand them to identify mixedSectionsComplexUnit with the homotopy right-derived unit and the conjugated counit e with epsilon. The mapHomotopyCategory_unit_app_quotient and mapHomotopyCategory_map formulas identify sections of the homotopy adjunction unit with the quotient of the degreewise ordinary sections-unit map. Apply mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh_hom_app to the termwise T-sections complex, simplify its identity components, and cancel the factor hom to identify the inverse homotopy scalar factor with the inverse complex scalar factor. Substituting these identities into the homotopy sections identity gives exactly the original complex equation.

theorem mixedPullback_sections_counit_unit {S T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ S)
    [(Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).Additive]
    [(RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor S.toRingedSpace).Additive]
    [(RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor T.toRingedSpace).Additive]
    (C : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ derivedPullback.{u, w} g ⟶
      (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ) ⋙
        DerivedCategory.Qh
          (C := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)))
    (hunit :
      (schemeHomPullbackAdjunction.{u, w} g).homEquiv
          (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj C))
          ((DerivedCategory.Qh
            (C := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace))).obj
            (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj
              ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj C)))
          (ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj C) ≫
            (DerivedCategory.Qh
              (C := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace))).map (𝟙 _)) =
      (DerivedCategory.Qh
        (C := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace))).map
        (((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction g)).mapHomotopyCategory
          (.up ℤ)).homEquiv ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj C) _ (𝟙 _)) ≫
        (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage g.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app
          (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g).mapHomotopyCategory (.up ℤ)).obj
            ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj C))) :
    let H := RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor S.toRingedSpace
    let J := RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor T.toRingedSpace
    let K : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace) ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace) := Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g
    let R := ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} g.appTop.hom
    let d : H ⟶ K ⋙ J ⋙ R := Functor.whiskerRight
      (Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction g)).unit H
    let D := (K.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C
    let e : (derivedPullback.{u, w} g).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C) ⟶ DerivedCategory.Q.obj D :=
      (derivedPullback.{u, w} g).map ((DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso _).inv.app C) ≫
        ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj C) ≫
        (DerivedCategory.Qh
          (C := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace))).map
          ((K.mapHomotopyCategoryFactors (.up ℤ)).hom.app C) ≫
        (DerivedCategory.quotientCompQhIso
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace))).hom.app D
    mixedSectionsComplexUnit S C ≫
      (schemeDerivedGlobalSections S).map
        ((schemeHomPullbackAdjunction.{u, w} g).unit.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C)) ≫
      (mixedGlobalSectionsDirectImageIso g).hom.app
        ((derivedPullback.{u, w} g).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C)) ≫
      (schemeGlobalScalarRestriction g).map ((schemeDerivedGlobalSections T).map e) =
    DerivedCategory.Q.map ((d.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).app C) ≫
      R.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app ((J.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj D) ≫
      (schemeGlobalScalarRestriction g).map (mixedSectionsComplexUnit T D)
